mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.2% signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 7.5% for 3 consecutive months, it indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) below 900 thousand units and industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 index indicate synchronized contraction in consumer demand and manufacturing output, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances when HOUST < 900 and INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: In inflationary regimes (CPIAUCSL > 230) with persistent interest rate hikes (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), the Federal Reserve's tightening policy reduces equity valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in > 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) above 135 million persons indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profitability, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 45% of instances when PAYEMS > 135 million.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 850 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces construction activity and consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in > 65% of instances when HOUST < 850.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 index and retail sales (RSAFS) below 420,000 million dollars indicate a synchronized contraction in manufacturing output and consumer spending, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and RSAFS < 420000.

mechanism_narrative: In weak economic expansion regimes (GDPC1 level < 13,500 billion dollars) with manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO < 95), supply-side constraints reduce corporate output and profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in > 55% of instances when GDPC1 < 13500 and INDPRO < 95.
